title: AddendumMeta
description: The addendum lane's record of one buyer amendment (addenda/<addendum_id>/meta.json; B37/D18, G4; P32b / P1-8 narrow): what arrived, what the advisory impact scan found, and the human decision — note_only routes the impacts into the review loop as pending comments; replan supersedes the live plan, archives the frozen plan and the draft pair intact beside this file and attests each archive by digest here. The record holds a human decision and the digests that vouch for the archives, so a file that fails this schema is a typed refusal at the lane, never rewritten (B130; B145 §3d).

addendum_id.description: max+1 over the folders present (the P1-20/P1-22 rule), never a count.

filename.description: The stored upload's plain basename; the lane's own record names (meta.json, *.superseded.json) are refused at the door (P3-21).

by.description: The operator who uploaded it (session identity).

scanned.description: true when the upload decoded as text and the impact scan ran; false for a binary upload (then note says so and the human reads it directly).

note.description: Present only on an unscanned (binary) upload.

impacts.description: The advisory scan, ranked by score then section id: token overlap between the addendum text and each plan section's title + slot questions. No model call — the human decides what an amendment means.

decision.description: null until the human decides (the record is ADVISORY until then); a decided addendum refuses a second decision.

decision_note.description: The human's note; for replan it becomes the gate-2 redo feedback the replan consumes (required non-empty by the door).

archived_frozen_sha256.description: replan: the digest of plan.frozen.json as moved intact to addenda/<id>/plan.frozen.superseded.json (P25 item 5's one sanctioned move) — the archive is self-attesting.

archived_draft_sha256.description: replan: the pre-amendment drafts/draft.json as moved to draft.superseded.json (P25 item 8, P0-16).

archived_annotated_sha256.description: replan: the pre-amendment annotated draft as moved to annotated-draft.superseded.json.
